summary.result: The application results showed that the new model can generate the intensity of community facilities according to spatial distribution and accessibility from cities to the facilities.
summary.background: Although the frequency of use for community facilities in rural villages is growing as well as the importance of the facilities for urban-rural exchange is being highlighted, study on spatial location-analysis of the facilities for such multi-purpose is not so much.
summary.method: This study conducted GIS analysis for criteria of the location-evaluation model developed in this study.
